dedupe_keys.name: global anthropogenic heat flux from nighttime lights

description: This Figshare collection contains gridded global anthropogenic heat flux estimates inferred from nighttime light information. The collection lists coordinate files and heat-flux rasters in TIFF and NetCDF for 1992, 2001 and 2010. These grids can provide urban heat inputs or checks for models that link electricity use, buildings and outdoor temperature. They represent inferred flux, not a direct sensor record of waste heat. A simulation should keep the historical years and grid coordinates aligned with its land surface and population inputs; the deposit does not support an unqualified current-year heat estimate. All 10 member item(s) state CC0 in the Figshare article API; the collection DataCite registration says CC BY 4.0. I read the article and own repository metadata, without downloading or opening raster contents. No catalogue record with this deposit or named collection was found. A related but distinct G1 draft covers another anthropogenic heat product with a 2050 scenario; users should not merge them without checking methods.
